headline: Access Holdings Reports N1.22 Trillion in Foreign Earnings for 9M 2026
summary: Access Holdings led Nigerian commercial banks by generating N1.22 trillion in foreign operations revenue during the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026.
why: Access Holdings is Nigeria's largest financial services holding company with commercial banking subsidiaries across Africa and Europe.

impacts.name: Access Holdings
impacts.why: Access Holdings reported leading foreign earnings of N1.22 trillion in its 9M financial results.
